newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat mostly lower amid rain outlooks.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat mostly lower amid rain outlooks.

text.p: Forecasts for rain in the dry wheat areas of western Kansas pressed KCBT hard red winter wheat futures lower by midsession, traders said.
USDA Monday said that as of Sunday, the U.S. winter wheat crop was 50 percent good to excellent, below the 53 percent in that category the previous week.
But traders said satisfactory production prospects remained and the outlook for showers should boost the Kansas crop outlook.
Meteorologists said rain was likely in western kansas over the next five days.
The spot May contract was firm on shortcovering before its expiration at 1201 CDT.
At 1044, KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were five cents lower to one cent higher, with July down 2-1/2 at $4.17 per bushel.
